question: Should this PR merge with local six-process concurrency proof and a known untested remote-storage URI boundary, or should remote LanceDB concurrency proof be required first?
rationale: The patch changes persistent-store startup behavior across the generic LanceDB connection boundary, and the available real-behavior proof covers local storage only; selecting the supported operational contract is a maintainer risk decision.

options.title: Accept the bounded local-proof scope
options.body: Accept the dependency-native `existOk` strategy and bounded readiness retry as sufficient for supported remote URIs, then let the normal exact-merge gate proceed.

options.title: Require remote-store proof first
options.body: Keep the PR paused until a representative supported remote LanceDB URI demonstrates concurrent initialization and error propagation.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded local-proof scope
recommendation.body: Accept the dependency-native `existOk` strategy and bounded readiness retry as sufficient for supported remote URIs, then let the normal exact-merge gate proceed.
